snapshot.title: Remove non-Planet-Hunters surveys from PostHog project
snapshot.description: The PostHog project (ID 199773) is shared across Star Sailors minigames. Active surveys for Bee Garden (Bumble) and DailySail are being shown to Planet Hunters Experiment 1 users because the PostHog JS SDK auto-displays all active popover surveys for a project token. These foreign surveys confuse Planet Hunters testers.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Surveys for Bee Garden/Bumble are archived or deleted from PostHog

Only Planet Hunters-relevant surveys remain active in the project
